Sweet Chocolate Bee with Xocai Chocolate
By: Xocai Chocolate
Published: Thursday, November 8, 2012 - 10:51am

Ingredients




3 ozs champagne (Korbel Champagne)
1 1/2 ozs liqueur (Armarula Creme Liqueur)
1 oz cointreau liqueur
1 oz dark chocolate (Xocai Activ liquid)
1/2 wedge orange

Preparation

1 Pour all ingredients into a cocktail shaker. Shake. Serves 2
